was a night-time map that took place in mountainous terrain, though poisoned water surrounded part of the map. Various circus tents, haybales, dead trees, lanterns and pumpkins could be seen around the map. Various buildings could also be seen. A rollercoaster, drop tower and ferris wheel could be seen on this map. A spider was seen by the gate.

The second version of

was a two-pathed map, so enemies alternated between the spawn points. The two paths started at two separate caves. One path passed underneath an archway and through the gate. Both paths crossed two wooden bridges over a murky pond and intersected just after the bridges. The path then crossed over two wooden bridges before reaching the end.

) had Halloween themes spread throughout the map. It was a night-time map though the map itself was brightly illuminated by the attractions. It appeared to take place in a graveyard with a visiting circus. Many background houses, caves and gates were spread throughout the map. There was a drop tower ride, which was animated, with circus tents around the map. Pumpkins, windmills, lantern lights and banners could be seen throughout the map.

The path began and ended at two caves. The path itself was quite long, revolving around a large hill, then revolving around the drop tower, running nearly parallel to the fourth straight at one point before twisting around to the end.
